title: Framework ModSecurity v3 provenance guard rejects the approved recursive source topology
title_de: Framework-ModSecurity-v3-Provenance-Guard weist die freigegebene rekursive Quelltopologie zurück
protocol: runtime component provenance and recursive Git submodules
profile: Parent PR #55 isolated current-runtime-evidence refresh using Framework master 784977615acfc55567e37b863309abc4a38ac877
technical_claim: Framework rejects the exact approved ModSecurity v3 root checkout before source consumption solely because it declares committed .gitmodules and Gitlinks, although the retained recursive checkout has the approved root origin and commit, eight initialized pinned submodules, clean status, and git fsck PASS.
entry_point: Framework ci_require_approved_modsecurity_v3_checkout invoked by Apache, NGINX, and direct ModSecurity v3 source preparation
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: The Parent provisioner recursively initializes the approved ModSecurity source, then Framework's common.sh guard rejects all .gitmodules/mode-160000 content before it can validate the approved topology. The result blocks Apache/NGINX source consumption before any build sink.
attacker_prerequisites: A caller supplies a ModSecurity v3 source directory to the Framework build path.
The source directory is a recursively initialized checkout of the pinned approved root.
observed_behavior: Both Apache and NGINX build logs stop with BLOCKED: ModSecurity v3 checkout declares submodules without an approved provenance rule. The retained component inventory reports the root origin https://github.com/owasp-modsecurity/ModSecurity.git, root commit 0fb4aff98b4980cf6426697d5605c424e3d5bb60, git fsck PASS, recursive_submodules true, submodule_count 8, and submodule_status_clean true.
expected_behavior: Framework must accept only the exact clean approved root plus the exact complete recursively pinned Gitlink topology for that root commit. It must reject a missing, dirty, uninitialized, extra, path-mismatched, origin-mismatched, or commit-mismatched child before source consumption. A generic acceptance of submodules is not acceptable.
impact: The current guard remains fail-closed, so no unapproved source is known to have reached a build. It also blocks the legitimate approved source that Parent provisioned, preventing Apache and NGINX components from being built and blocking the fresh PR #55 runtime-evidence cycle.
preconditions: The root HEAD is 0fb4aff98b4980cf6426697d5605c424e3d5bb60 and recursive Gitlinks are initialized.
reproduction: Run the isolated Parent runtime-component preparation with its private Framework/MRTS copies only.
Observe Apache and NGINX fail before a build with the common.sh submodule-provenance blocker.
Inspect the retained component inventory and source checkout metadata for clean root, recursive Gitlinks, origins, commits, and git fsck status.

evidence.command: isolated Parent runtime component preparation Apache consumer path
evidence.summary: The Apache consumer was blocked by the Framework message that the checkout declares submodules without an approved provenance rule.

evidence.command: isolated Parent runtime component preparation NGINX consumer path
evidence.summary: The NGINX consumer was blocked by the same Framework guard before it consumed the approved source.

evidence.command: isolated make prepare-runtime-components and retained runtime-component inventory review
evidence.summary: The retained inventory records the approved root, git fsck PASS, eight recursively initialized pinned submodules, and clean submodule status.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped focused topology/provenance suite, Framework Make provenance contract, documentation checks, full Framework lint, and independent focused security re-review
evidence.summary: The local candidate accepted the exact approved root plus eight-child topology and rejected the modeled missing, extra, uninitialized, dirty, path, origin, commit, symlink, external-gitdir, worktree, and configuration variants. The focused suite, Make contract, documentation checks, and full lint passed.

root_cause: ci_require_approved_modsecurity_v3_checkout deliberately rejects any .gitmodules manifest or mode-160000 Gitlink before checking a topology-specific provenance rule. The exact approved upstream root commit legitimately contains a recursive pinned submodule graph, so the blanket policy rejects the intended approved source rather than validating it.
proposed_remediation: The local candidate retains the exact root origin/commit/ref and hardened Git-environment controls, replaces categorical .gitmodules/Gitlink rejection with a static approved eight-child (path, origin, commit) topology, and verifies clean root/child worktrees, canonical worktrees, child-gitdir containment, remotes, detached HEADs, and recursive status. It initializes recursively only after the pinned root and scrubs local recursive-update configuration before explicit checkout semantics. Missing, extra, dirty, uninitialized, altered, path/origin/commit-mismatched, symlinked, escaping, or unparseable topology fails closed; arbitrary recursive submodules remain prohibited.
acceptance_criteria: The existing exact root-origin, root-commit, absolute-path, and alias/ref controls remain fail-closed.
A clean exact approved root plus its complete known eight-submodule recursive topology is accepted without the validator mutating the checkout.
Missing, dirty, uninitialized, extra, unexpected-origin, unexpected-path, and root/nested commit mismatch cases fail before source consumption.
Framework fresh source preparation initializes the pinned topology only after root verification and reuses the hardened Git execution path.
Focused non-network regressions cover the legitimate control and alternate bypass cases; EN/DE documentation no longer claims that all v3 submodules are categorically rejected.
validation_plan: Replace the old categorical-rejection test with explicit fixtures for the known clean topology and independent negative cases.
Run focused Framework ModSecurity v3 provenance tests, shell syntax, and documentation/Change Record checks with generated files outside source trees.
Perform a focused security review for static allowlist completeness, dirty-worktree handling, child path confinement, origin/commit binding, and fresh-fetch ordering.
Re-run isolated Parent component preparation only after separately reviewed Parent cache and Framework provenance repairs are available.
legitimate_control_tests: The exact approved root with the known clean eight-submodule topology is accepted by Apache, NGINX, and direct v3 consumer gates.
The Framework fresh-fetch path begins only after the root is pinned and validates the same topology through the hardened Git wrapper.
bypass_review: The repair must reject dirty or untracked root/child worktrees, child symlinks/path escape, missing or additional Gitlinks, a known path with different origin or commit, and any recursive status marker that indicates a non-exact checkout. The currently observed issue is availability fail-closed; no successful source-provenance bypass is asserted.
dependencies: The reviewed upstream ModSecurity v3 root and its committed recursive Gitlink topology
A separate Parent cache repair tracked as FND-PARENT-0042
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-FRAMEWORK-0027 or FND-FRAMEWORK-0028. Those findings own literal parsing and partial automatic-update identity behavior. This record owns the separately reproducible false rejection of the already approved recursive checkout by the Framework runtime guard.
evidence_limitations: The evidence proves an availability/CI false rejection and that the inspected cached topology is clean; it does not demonstrate a successful supply-chain bypass.

The existing guard does not currently prove clean root/child worktrees when it rejects all submodules; dirty-worktree validation is a required hardening property of the repair, not a separately validated exploit.
The local proof is an isolated Framework candidate and does not establish a successful Parent runtime lifecycle or a delivered Framework revision.
The companion local-Git finding FND-FRAMEWORK-0032 is fixed in the same candidate, but neither finding is verified until the independent Framework PR and resulting-master lifecycle complete.
residual_risk: The exact topology guard is fixed locally and remains fail-closed; it does not generically accept .gitmodules or recursive submodules. A separate Framework PR, exact-head checks/review/Sonar evidence, Framework-master verification, a separately authorized Parent gitlink update, the independent FND-PARENT-0042 repair, and fresh FND-CROSS-0001 runtime evidence remain required before Parent PR #55 can progress. No Framework master, Parent gitlink, or MRTS action has occurred.

history.detail: Apache and NGINX consumer logs both stopped at the categorical Framework submodule-provenance blocker, while the retained inventory reported the exact approved root, recursive initialization, eight pinned children, and clean status.

The defect was separated from the Parent NGINX cache mismatch and prior Framework ModSecurity v3 findings. A Framework-only fail-closed topology validation repair is feasible; no Framework/MRTS delivery action occurred.

The in-progress topology candidate exposed FND-FRAMEWORK-0032: task-owned real-Git evidence proved local core.fsmonitor execution, core.worktree redirection, and missing read-only guarantees. The topology repair remains in_progress but cannot be delivered until the P0 finding is fixed and verified.

The candidate installed the static exact eight-child topology guard, hardened and contained fresh recursive initialization, and passed focused topology/configuration negatives, legitimate controls, Make, lint, documentation, Change Record, and independent review. Status is fixed, not verified, because no Framework PR or master verification exists.
